plan.notes: Source: official Bank Street Graduate School of Education website, 'Accelerated Early Childhood and Childhood General Education Master's Degree Programs for Wesleyan University Students' page (crawled 2026-10-01) — 'Bank Street Curriculum' term-by-term table transcribed verbatim. This is the Bank Street-Wesleyan accelerated pathway: Wesleyan students/recent graduates transfer 8 undergraduate credits (saving >25% tuition); 33 credits completed at Bank Street. Wesleyan prerequisites (not part of the 33; undergraduate courses, no credits published on this page): PSYC 230 Developmental Psychology, PSYC 340 Migration and Child Development, EDST 224 History & Current Forces Shaping Special Education, EDST 335 Celebrating Learner Differences: Creating Inclusive Classrooms Using Research, EDST 230 School and Society, and one of EDST 358 Fugitive Perspectives or EDST 340 The Politics of Education. Bank Street's degrees table lists the standard program at the same 33 credits for the MSEd or EdM (eligibility depends on prerequisites). CST and EAS are New York State Teacher Certification examinations (0 credits), not courses. EDUC 837-1 Integrative Master's Project appears in both Summer (0cr) and Fall 4 (0cr, 'if more time is needed') per the official table; it is a continuing 0-credit project, not a duplicate course. The official page carries the disclaimer 'Course sequence is subject to change'. Per-course prerequisites are not published; prereq lists are empty. Bank Street publishes no dated academic catalog; sequence taken from the live official website (last_verified 2026-10-01). Program leads to eligibility for New York State certification, Birth-Grade 2. DISCREPANCY (documented, not resolved): the official table prints Summer 'CREDITS PER TERM' 6 and 'TOTAL CREDITS TO BE COMPLETED AT BANK STREET' 33, but the listed Summer courses sum to 3 (EAS 0 + EDUC 837-1 0 + EDUC 994 1 + EDUC 540 2). The Childhood General Education table on the same page is internally consistent (its Summer adds EDUC 564, 3cr, reaching 6). The Early Childhood table appears to omit a 3-credit Summer course or misprints the subtotal. Per collection rules the sequenced sum (30) is recorded and no credits were invented; total_credits reflects the courses as listed. [Coordinator 2026-10-01: allow_repeated_courses=true because Bank Street's official term-by-term table genuinely lists EDUC 837-1 Integrative Master's Project in two consecutive terms; CST/EAS are 0-credit NYSTCE exam requirements flagged required_zero.]
